අƯ ɪෙශෂ EXTRAORDINARY
(Published by Authority)
PART III – LANDSPART III – LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The land speciﬁed below in the Advance Tracing No. KU/KPW/2021/662 dated 27.07.2023, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village of Kithalawa in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 1142 of Kithalawa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kuliyapitiya - West in the District of Kurunegala, North Western Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Nagaland Estate – Extent: About 0.1518 Hectare North: Nagaland Estate claimed by Janatha Estates Development Board and Nagaland Estate claimed by Sunil Abeywardhana; East and South: Nagaland Estate claimed by Pradeshiya Sabha, Kuliyapitiya, Lot B and Nagaland Estate
claimed by Land Reform Commission; West: Nagaland Estate claimed by Janatha Estates Development Board.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Nagaland Estate – Extent: About 0.0215 Hectare North: Lot A and Nagaland Estate claimed by Pradeshiya Sabha, Kuliyapitiya; East: Nagaland Estate claimed by Pradeshiya Sabha, Kuliyapitiya and the Road; South: Road and the Nagaland Estate claimed by Land Reform Commission; West: Nagaland Estate claimed by Land Reform Commission and Lot A.
K. D. LAL KANTHA, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation.
My No.: 4-3/18/2021/WS/125.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.24th November, 2025.
